description:
NEW TO THE MARKET

NO. 63 PÁIRC NA RÍ, ATHENRY, CO. GALWAY, H65 TP38

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to present to the market this superb A3-rated three-bedroom two-storey residence, ideally located within the highly regarded Páirc Na Rí development in the historic and thriving town of Athenry, Co. Galway.

Presented in excellent condition throughout, this impressive modern home offers bright, spacious and exceptionally well-appointed accommodation, combining contemporary design, energy efficiency and an excellent location.

No. 63 enjoys all the benefits of modern family living, including an A3 Building Energy Rating, underfloor heating to the ground floor, zoned heating, broadband connectivity and mains services.

The property is superbly positioned just a 10-minute walk from Athenry town centre and Athenry Railway Station, offering convenient access to an extensive range of shops, schools, restaurants, sporting facilities and everyday amenities.

Athenry also benefits from excellent road and rail connectivity, with convenient access to the M6 motorway and regular rail services connecting the town with Galway City, Dublin and Limerick.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, spacious sitting room, kitchen/dining area, utility room and guest WC on the ground floor, together with three bedrooms, master ensuite and main family bathroom at first-floor level.

ACCOMMODATION

Entrance Hall

Bright and welcoming entrance hallway featuring attractive timber-effect tiled flooring and staircase leading to the first-floor accommodation.

Sitting Room

A beautifully presented and comfortable reception room featuring timber-effect tiled flooring, dual-aspect windows with fitted blinds for additional privacy, solid-fuel stove with granite hearth and attractive feature lighting.

Double French doors provide direct access to the kitchen and dining area, creating an excellent flow between the principal living spaces.

Kitchen / Dining Area

Bright and spacious kitchen and dining area ideally designed for modern family living.

The kitchen features an extensive range of fitted units with timber worktops, tiled splashbacks, electric hob, oven and extractor fan, integrated dishwasher and fridge freezer.

Timber-effect tiled flooring continues throughout, while double patio doors provide excellent natural light and direct access to the rear garden and patio area.

The kitchen further benefits from a dedicated boiler room and additional storage.

Utility Room

Well-appointed utility room featuring fitted units, timber worktop, timber-effect tiled flooring and plumbing for appliances.

A PVC rear entrance door provides direct access to the garden.

Guest WC

Comprising WC and wash hand basin, vanity/storage unit with mirror and attractive timber-effect tiled flooring.

FIRST FLOOR

Landing

The first-floor landing features fitted carpet flooring, hot press and Stira stairs providing access to a floored attic offering excellent additional storage space.

Master Bedroom

Spacious and beautifully presented master bedroom featuring timber flooring, fitted window blind and built-in wardrobe accommodation.

Ensuite

Fully tiled ensuite comprising WC, wash hand basin and pumped shower.

Bedroom Two

Generously proportioned bedroom featuring timber flooring, fitted wardrobe and remote-controlled window blinds.

Bedroom Three

Well-proportioned bedroom featuring timber flooring, additional storage space and remote-controlled window blinds.

Main Bathroom

Attractive and contemporary family bathroom finished to a high standard throughout.

The bathroom is fully tiled and comprises a white bathroom suite, bath with overhead shower and stylish wall-mounted wash hand basin complemented by a digital mirror.

OUTSIDE

The property enjoys an attractive and low-maintenance exterior.

To the front is a tarmacadam driveway providing off-street parking, complemented by an attractive cobble-block footpath and carefully maintained flowers and shrubbery.

A gated side entrance provides convenient access to the rear garden.

The enclosed rear garden features a patio area ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining, together with a Steeltech shed and additional open storage area.

An outside electricity supply is also available.

LOCATION

Páirc Na Rí is a modern residential development conveniently located just a 10-minute walk from Athenry town centre and Athenry Railway Station.

Athenry offers an excellent selection of primary and secondary schools, supermarkets, shops, restaurants, sporting facilities, medical services and public transport connections.

The property is particularly well positioned for commuters, with convenient access to the M6 motorway connecting Athenry with Galway City and Dublin.

The town is also an important rail hub, with services connecting Athenry to Galway, Dublin and Limerick.

VIEWING

No. 63 Páirc Na Rí represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a modern, energy-efficient and beautifully presented three-bedroom home in one of Athenry’s most convenient residential locations.

Combining an A3 energy rating, excellent accommodation, modern heating systems, private outdoor space and the convenience of being just a 10-minute walk from Athenry town centre and railway station, this property is ideally suited to first-time buyers, families and commuters alike.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
